blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — A city councilor here has called out the Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) for serving snacks from an American fast-food chain during its regular session, despite a resolution calling for a boycott of companies linked to countries supporting Israel in the war with Palestine. During Tuesday’s session, Councilor Shalimar Candao took the podium to deliver a privilege speech, asking the SP food staff to remove the spaghetti and chicken snacks prepared for the city legislators and personnel. The serving of American snacks occurred despite a resolution authored by Candao, which was approved on April 14, 2026, urging the city government to […]...
